parameters.query: SELECT CASE '{{ $json.command }}' WHEN '/status' THEN (SELECT json_build_object('type', 'status', 'active_workflows', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_execution_stats WHERE started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'), 'errors_1h', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_execution_stats WHERE status = 'error' AND started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'), 'total_contacts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts), 'active_deals', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')))::text WHEN '/leads' THEN (SELECT json_build_object('type', 'leads', 'today', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE created_at > CURRENT_DATE), 'hot', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE lead_score >= 80), 'recent', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name', first_name || ' ' || last_name, 'company', company, 'score', lead_score)) FROM (SELECT * FROM contacts WHERE created_at > CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5) sub))::text WHEN '/pipeline' THEN (SELECT json_build_object('type', 'pipeline', 'total_value', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value),0) FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')), 'deal_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')), 'won_mtd', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value),0) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won' AND updated_at > date_trunc('month', NOW()))))::text WHEN '/seo' THEN (SELECT json_build_object('type', 'seo', 'keywords', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracked_keywords WHERE is_active = true), 'top10', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM keyword_rankings WHERE position <= 10 AND checked_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'), 'backlinks', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM backlinks WHERE is_active = true)))::text END as result
